name: list_clickpipes
description: Lists the ClickPipes of a ClickHouse service. Each entry has id, name, description, state, scaling, source and destination configuration, field mappings, and creation and update times; returns an empty array when the service has none. Pass an id to get_clickpipe for the fully typed definition of one pipe. If the lookup fails, result is an error object.

organizationId.description: Organization that owns the service. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.

serviceId.description: ClickHouse service whose ClickPipes to list. Use the id of a clickhouse-type service returned by get_services_list.
